name: MonarchRookBar
title: RookBar
summary: The Rook company bar for the public, signed-out screens of a Rook app: the app's wordmark, the account buttons and a menu button that opens the company menu (products, services, pricing, news) in a full-height bottom sheet. Rook-scoped.
whenToUse: At the top of the signed-out screens of a Rook app that should match the company site.
whenNotToUse: Inside the signed-in app, use the app shell (rook-rail). Outside Rook, use MonarchSiteShell or MonarchMegaMenu in the app's own navigation.
api: @Composable fun MonarchRookBar(brand: String, items: List<MonarchMegaMenuItem>, menuOpen: Boolean, onMenuOpenChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, onNavigate: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, account: MonarchRookBarAccount? = null, onAccountAction: (MonarchRookBarAction) -> Unit = {}, brandMark: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onBrandClick: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchRookBarLabels = MonarchRookBarLabels())
sealed interface MonarchRookBarAccount { data object SignedOut; data class SignedIn(val name: String) }
enum class MonarchRookBarAction { SignIn, SignUp, Dashboard, Account, SignOut }
class MonarchRookBarLabels(nav: String? = null, openMenu: String? = null, signIn: String? = null, signUp: String? = null, dashboard: String? = null, account: String? = null, signOut: String? = null)

options.name: brand
options.description: The app's name beside its mark.

options.name: items
options.description: The company menu: Products, Services, Pricing and News, with sections, links and featured cards.

options.name: menuOpen
options.description: Whether the menu sheet is shown.

options.name: onMenuOpenChange
options.description: Called with true by the menu button and false when the sheet closes.

options.name: onNavigate
options.description: Called with the link the user taps; the sheet closes first.

options.name: account
options.description: SignedOut ("Log in", "Sign up") or SignedIn(name) ("Open dashboard", "Account settings", "Sign out"); null shows none.

options.name: onAccountAction
options.description: Called with the account action the user taps.

options.name: brandMark
options.description: The app's mark before the name.

options.name: onBrandClick
options.description: Called when the brand is tapped, normally to go home; null makes the brand plain text.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Rook", "Open menu", "Log in", "Sign up", "Open dashboard", "Account settings" and "Sign out".

states.name: signed out
states.description: The inverse "Sign up" pill sits in the bar from 288dp wide and "Log in" beside it from 448dp, at font scale 1.3 or less; both are always at the end of the menu sheet.

states.name: signed in
states.description: The sheet ends with the person's name, "Open dashboard", "Account settings" and "Sign out".

states.name: menu open
states.description: A full-height bottom sheet with the company menu as a MonarchMegaMenu.

appearance: The bar is the surface with a subtle line under it; the brand uses the default text in the subheading style; "Sign up" is a MonarchButton in the Inverse variant with the full shape, as on the company site. The menu uses MonarchMegaMenu's roles. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web RookBar shows the menus in the bar with hover panels (an app catalog, a featured panel, recent posts) and a full-height sheet on phones. On Android the bar always uses the sheet, as the web does on phones, and the panels are MonarchMegaMenu entries: app categories are sections with their promise as the description, the catalog's "Every app" is the featured card, and recent posts are links with their label and date. The bar never fetches; the app passes the posts. The web's colorScheme, position and cross-app cookie options do not apply.
accessibility: The bar is a traversal group named "Rook"; the menu sheet is a pane with the same name.
The menu button is named "Open menu" and has a 48dp touch target.
The menu entries are MonarchMegaMenu rows: buttons that read their expanded state; external links say they open outside the app.
Account buttons are buttons with touch targets of at least 48dp.
edgeCases: Above font scale 1.3 the account buttons are only in the sheet, so the brand keeps its room.
The sheet closes before onNavigate and onAccountAction are called.

examples.code:
MonarchRookBar(
    brand = "Northwind",
    items = items,
    menuOpen = menuOpen,
    onMenuOpenChange = { menuOpen = it },
    onNavigate = { page = it },
    account = MonarchRookBarAccount.SignedOut,
    onAccountAction = { page = it.name },
    brandMark = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Grid, contentDescription = null) },
    onBrandClick = { page = "home" },
)
